headline: As of 2026-10-24: 25,712,303 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 47 of 50 states, D+11.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 25,712,303 early/mail ballots cast so far across 47 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (3,501,750), California (2,758,100), Florida (2,340,790).
